hub_ruling_2026_08_08._source: ai-maestro hub, relayed cross-session and VERIFIED against Emasoft/ai-maestro@governance-rules tip f3f02743 (design/tasks/TRDD-...-9SEQ4QI9-...md). Citations were checked before acting: the commit exists, IS the branch tip, and the card is present.
hub_ruling_2026_08_08.ruling: The SPEC's granular renderings (R22.1..R22.5 / R23.1..R23.8) are the NORMATIVE form. The DOC's verbatim blocks — what is vendored here — are PROVENANCE: the source being rendered. Coexistence is fine, so these fixtures do NOT need re-capturing from the spec.
hub_ruling_2026_08_08.condition: Coexistence is fine ONLY IF the normative declaration is stated WHERE THE CLAUSES LIVE. So the restore must carry, next to the blocks, an explicit line saying the spec's granular form is normative and this doc text is the provenance copy — otherwise a reader takes the vendored prose as the rule.
hub_ruling_2026_08_08.consequence_for_this_file: These fixtures stay as they are. Their sha256 pins and the doc line ranges remain the right thing to verify against. The spec extents recorded above are retained as a cross-reference, not as a re-vendoring target.
hub_ruling_2026_08_08.fleet_note: A fleet check is warranted — every plugin that vendored the doc pinned provenance rather than the normative form — and each repo does its own Tier-0 pass. This repo's pass is this entry.
